text: つよく　なれば　ガードマンの　かわりに　なるしね

structure.jp: ガードマンの　かわりに　なるしね
structure.en: they can stand in for a security guard, after all

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing the end of a verb to ば makes it 'if'. つよく　なれば = 'if they get strong'.

patterns.name: 〜のかわりになる
patterns.span: ガードマンの　かわりに　なる
patterns.explanation: A thing plus のかわりになる says something takes that thing's place. ガードマンの　かわりに　なる = 'they stand in for a security guard'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し at the end gives a reason, with the feeling that there are other reasons too. なるしね = 'they'd serve as one, after all'.
